test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

She read the story aloud to the class in a calm and steady ______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**manner**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**manner**" means a way in which something is done or happens.
 
• In the given sentence, "manner" fits the context perfectly as it describes how the story was read.
 
• The other options: "**meaner**," "**miner**," and "**manor**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She read the story aloud to the class in a calm and steady manner__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Meaner**: means more unpleasant or cruel.
 
• **Miner**: refers to a person who works in a mine.
 
• **Manor**: refers to a large country house or estate.
